basic_details.job_title: KVASU Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (KVASU) has notified 2 temporary vacancies for the Research Assistant post with a tenure of up to 24 months, subject to project fund availability. Candidates applying for the position must hold an M.Sc. in Biotechnology, M.Sc. in Biostatistics, M.Sc. in Biochemistry, or B.V.Sc. & A.H., with a pay of Rs. 1,400 per day up to a maximum of Rs. 35,000 per month. Eligible applicants must submit their biodata or CV along with scanned copies of supporting documents by email or by post to the Principal Investigator on or before 21 October 2026 at 11:00 A

vacancy_details.details: There are a total of 02 vacancies for the Research Assistant post under the KVASU-EDF Project at the College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Pookode, Wayanad, Kerala.

how_to_apply: Prepare your biodata or CV containing all relevant credentials, research output, educational qualifications, and experience.
Gather scanned copies of supporting documents to prove your identity, age, and qualifications.

Send the application via email to [email protected] or mail it by post to the Principal Investigator, KVASU–EDF Project, Department of Animal Nutrition, College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Pookode, Wayanad, Kerala – 673 576.
Ensure that your application reaches the designated email address or postal address on or before 11:00 AM on 21st October 2026.
Attend the interview on 26th October 2026 at 11:00 AM carrying original certificates, testimonials, and one set of self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 02 vacancies for the Research Assistant post under the KVASU-EDF Project at the College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Pookode, Wayanad, Kerala.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential qualifications and meet the age criteria specified below: Essential Qualifications: M.Sc. in Biotechnology, M.Sc. in Biostatistics, M.Sc. in Biochemistry, or B.V.Sc. & A.H. Desirable Qualification: At least one year of experience in a research project. Age Limit: Below 45 years as on 9th October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Assistants will receive a remuneration of ₹1,400 per day, subject to a monthly maximum of ₹35,000. The appointment is purely temporary and on a daily-wage basis for up to 24 months from the date of joining, depending on project fund availability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVASU Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare your biodata or CV containing all relevant credentials, research output, educational qualifications, and experience. Gather scanned copies of supporting documents to prove your identity, age, and qualifications. Send the application via email to [email protected] or mail it by post to the Principal Investigator, KVASU–EDF Project, Department of Animal Nutrition, College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Pookode, Wayanad, Kerala – 673 576. Ensure that your application reaches the designated email address or postal address on or before 11:00 AM on 21st October 2026. Attend the interview on 26th October 2026 at 11:00 AM carrying original certificates, testimonials, and one set of self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates who submit their biodata and supporting documents within the deadline are required to appear for an interview on 26th October 2026 (Monday) at 11:00 AM at the College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Pookode, Wayanad, Kerala. Candidates must bring all original certificates and testimonials along with self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q1. Is the KVASU Research Assistant position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and on a daily-wage basis for up to 24 months from the date of joining, subject to project fund availability.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any age relaxations specified in the notice?
faq.answer: The notification states the age limit as below 45 years as on 9th October 2026 and does not specify any category-wise age relaxations.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications for this post?
faq.answer: The desirable qualification is at least one year of experience in a research project.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates appearing for the interview must bring original certificates and testimonials to prove their identity, age, educational qualifications, experience, research output, and other relevant credentials, along with one set of self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents.
